SpotLike constant spot (0x65C7...34A3). External Spotter; poke(bytes32) is called with hardcoded ilk names from process() and poke().
internal process(): unconditionally guarded external .pass()/.poke() calls on 21 OSMs and spot.poke() for 23 ilks. No parameters, no return, no access control.
external poke(): calls process(), then pass()/poke() on univ2wbtcdai and univ2aaveeth, then spot.poke() for UNIV2WBTCDAI-A and UNIV2AAVEETH-A. Publicly callable by anyone.
external pokeTemp(): only calls process(); publicly callable by anyone, intended for OSMs before collateral is added.

Aggregated external calls eth/bat/btc/knc/zrx/mana/usdt/comp/link/lrc/yfi/bal/uni/aave/univ2daieth/univ2wbtceth/univ2usdceth/univ2daiusdc/univ2ethusdt/univ2linketh/univ2unieth .pass()/.poke() inside process() on untrusted external OSM contracts.
Aggregated external calls spot.poke(bytes32) inside process() with hardcoded ilk strings on the untrusted Spotter contract.
External calls univ2wbtcdai.pass()/poke() and univ2aaveeth.pass()/poke() inside poke() on untrusted external OSM contracts.
External calls spot.poke("UNIV2WBTCDAI-A") and spot.poke("UNIV2AAVEETH-A") inside poke() on the untrusted Spotter contract.
Implicit caller of the unrestricted external entry points poke() and pokeTemp(); no owner/authorization check guards these functions.

edges.reason: poke() calls the internal process() helper before its own additional pokes.
pokeTemp() calls the internal process() helper.
process() invokes pass()/poke() on external OSM contracts; these untrusted external calls can reenter the protocol entry points.
process() invokes spot.poke(bytes32) on an external contract, an untrusted external call.
poke() invokes pass()/poke() on univ2wbtcdai and univ2aaveeth, untrusted external calls.
poke() invokes spot.poke(bytes32) on an external contract, an untrusted external call.
